notes: Simulation: Lazy Points tick up on their own and flicking the lights doubles the multiplier, so this is the idle-incremental family where the number going up is the game. It is not P5 and not a SET — the answer makes it a small room the player walks around with the switches reachable on the walls — and interior-single from the shared catalogue is exactly that black box as the entire map, with no exterior and no transition, so it routes P0. Incremental Simulator with its shape substituted: station-training is the light switches, the repeatable thing that raises the number, and social-hub is bent to the wall of game-pass donation buttons the prompt puts on the left wall; gate-progression and path-circulation were dropped because the answer says the game accumulates forever with no unlocks and a single small room has nothing to circulate between. Decided without a user: the lights in the top corners and the switches are fixtures on the room's own walls rather than separate zones, so the room plus those two picks is the whole layout job.
